verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story. Webhooks report changes to Plaid Items, the hosted Dashboard MCP server offers Production diagnostics for debugging Items, and the Node SDK exposes structured error response data. None of this is documented as per-institution health status, and none of it explicitly separates bank-side failures from integration errors. missing for 10: documented institution status/health endpoint, outage or degradation signals per institution, an error-code taxonomy distinguishing institution errors from developer/user errors, independent or hands-on corroboration.
